title: Theorem 9.1: nonlinear clutching as a pullback of categories
statement_scope: Suppose given a pushout diagram of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks X01→X0, X01→X1, X0→X, X1→X, where i:X01→X0 and j:X01→X1 are closed immersions. Then the induced diagram of ∞-categories with corners Stk/X, Stk/X0, Stk/X1, Stk/X01 is a pullback square of ∞-categories. Complete statement and both directions of the equivalence are retained.
